name: Ferienhaus Seehäusl
beschreibung: The Seehäusl holiday home is located directly on the shore of Lake Thiersee in the municipality of Thiersee, Tirol. The location provides direct access to the lake and the surrounding hiking trails. In winter, guests reach the Thiersee ski area within a few minutes by car. The holiday home offers a fully equipped kitchen, a living room, and two bedrooms for up to four people. Amenities include a terrace with lake views and a garden area. The quiet and natural atmosphere makes the accommodation particularly suitable for couples and families seeking relaxation.
